decisive_items: Regular P waves evident marching onto QRS complexes
response.rationale: Regular narrow QRS tachycardia with independent P waves marching through QRS, varying PR intervals, and cannon waves/variable S1 indicates AV dissociation, best classified as supraventricular tachycardia; AVNRT would require a fixed 1:1 AV relationship.

rejected.why: AVNRT is incompatible with independent P waves marching onto QRS and varying PR intervals; these findings indicate AV dissociation rather than AVNRT.
